question: ____________ won the National Award for the Best Music Director for his music album in the movie 'Viswasam' at the 67th National Award.
solution:
The Correct answer is__** D Imman.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__ **

__
 
• The** 67th National Film Awards** were presented by** Vice President M. Venkaiah Naidu** in New Delhi on** 25 October 2021**.
 
• The award for Best Music Director went to **D Imman** for his exceptional work in the music album of the **Tamil **film **“Viswasam”**.
 
• His compositions added depth and emotion to the film, enhancing the overall cinematic experience.
 
• Actor Manoj Bajpayee was awarded the Best Actor award for Hindi movie '**Bhonsle**' and **Dhanush** got the award for **Tamil Movie 'Asuran**'.
 
• Veteran actor Rajnikanth was honored with the Dada Saheb Phalke Award.
 
• The Malayalam movie 'Marakkar Arabikkadilinte Simham' directed by Priyadarshan was awarded the Best Feature Film Award. 
 
• B. Praak got the Best Male Playback Singer award for the song "Teri Mitti" in Hindi Film 'Kesari'.
 
• Sanjay Puran Singh Chauhan was given the Best Direction Award for the Hindi film 'Bahattar Hoorain'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **National Film Awards**__:​

 __
 
• The National Film Awards is the most prominent film award ceremony in India.
 
• They were established in 1954.
 
• 
 
• They were first awarded on 10 October 1954.​
 
 
 
• **M Keeravani:**__
 __
 
• M M Keeravani recently made history at the Oscars with his joyously energetic anthem **“Naatu Naatu**__” from the film “**RRR**”.
 
• The song, **composed by Keeravani** with lyrics by Chandrabose, clinched the **Academy Award for Best Original Song**—a remarkable achievement for Indian cinema.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **__Important Points__**

__
 
• ** 68th National Flim Awards:**__

 __
 
• ​The winners of the **68th National Film Awards-2020** were announced by Information & Broadcasting Ministry on **22 July 2022 in New Delhi.**
 
• Marathi film **Funeral was** awarded **Best Film on Social Issues.**
 
• **Ajay Devgan** and **Suriya** got **Best Actor award **for films **Tanhaji**: The Unsung Warrior and Soorarai Pottru respectively.
 
• **Aparna Balamurali **got **Best Actress Award** for **Soorarai Pottru.**
 
• **Sachidanandan KR **got** Best Director Award **for** Malayalam Film AK Ayyappanum Koshiyum.**
 
• **Supratim Bhol **got **Best Cinematograph**y award for Bengali film **Avijatrik.**
 
• **Dadasaheb Phalke Award** for 2020 was given to actress **Asha Parekh **for her exemplary lifetime contribution to Indian Cinema.
 
 
 
• **69th National Film Awards:**__
 
 
• **​**The 69th National Film Awards ceremony took place on **October 17, 2023**, at the **Vigyan Bhawan in New Delhi, India****.** 
 
• During this event, the National Film Development Corporation of India honored outstanding **films from the year 2021 **in Indian cinema.
 
• The **Dadasaheb Phalke Award** winner, **Waheeda Rehman**, was felicitated by President **Draupadi Murmu.**
